summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Mara> running through a chain of connected spaces in one continuous tracking shot from behind.

retention_analysis:
<Mara> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her appearance and build are retained.

detailed_description:
Single continuous take, no cuts. Close over-the-shoulder tracking shot from just behind <Mara>'s right shoulder, her head and shoulder filling the left third of the frame, the path ahead visible past her. The camera stays locked at this distance as she runs, with handheld shake and bounce from her stride. Cinematic, realistic sci-fi, wet reflective surfaces, shallow depth of field, motion blur on the surroundings.
[Shot 1] Close over-the-shoulder shot from just behind <Mara>'s right shoulder as she sprints across the wet courtyard from <scene1>, puddles splashing below. Her foot skids and she lurches sideways, arm flinging out, then recovers. Past her shoulder, a worker by the roll-up door turns to stare. She ducks under the pipe gantry into the narrow gap between the buildings; the pipes sweep past the top of the frame, the camera staying tight behind her shoulder, and the alley from <scene2> appears past her shoulder. Splashing footsteps, hiss of steam. [Shot 2] At 00:05.0, the camera cuts to Close over-the-shoulder shot from just behind <Mara>'s right shoulder as she runs down the alley from <scene2>, wall lamps streaking past. A man with a metal case steps out of a doorway; she twists past him, her shoulder scraping the wall. She veers right and squeezes pass the just closing door; the door frame sweeps past the lens, the camera staying tight behind her shoulder, and the workshop from <scene3> appears past her shoulder, monitors glowing. Dripping water, the clang of the steel door. [Shot 3] At 00:10.0, the camera cuts to Close over-the-shoulder shot from just behind <Mara>'s right shoulder as she runs through the workshop from <scene3>, workbenches close on both sides, a worker looks up from his station in surprise. Her hip clips a bench and a wrench clatters to the floor; she stumbles, slaps a hand on the bench, and pushes on. She slams her shoulder into the steel door at the back; it swings open and blinding daylight floods the lens, the frame washing out to white for a moment, then the spaceport apron from <scene4> resolves past her shoulder. Clattering tools, the bang of the door.  Camera stays tight behind her shoulder. [Shot 4] At 00:15.0, the camera cuts to Close over-the-shoulder shot from just behind <Mara>'s shoulder as she runs out across the spaceport apron from <scene4>, the control tower ahead. A ground controller scene left in a high-visibility vest spots her and frantically holding out his palm in a 'stop' gesture.

(s1), the ground controller, a man with a General American accent, shouting in panic:
<d>[English] Hey! Stop!</d>

She swerves around him. On the left, the starship's underside engines ignite with a blinding flare. She skids to a stop, breathing hard, and her head snaps right toward an futuristic electric luggage cart a few steps away, the camera pans with her line of sight, a baggage worker beside it. Radio crackle, then rising engine roar.  Camera stays tight behind her shoulder. [Shot 5] At 00:20.0, the camera cuts to Close over-the-shoulder shot from just behind <Mara>'s right shoulder as she dashes to the futuristic electric luggage cart on the apron from <scene4> and vaults into the driver's seat, the camera dropping with her to ride behind her shoulder. On the right, the baggage worker throws his arms out in a "hey, wait a minute" gesture as she floors it.

She races past the starship lifting off on the left, its jet plume roaring upward, heat shimmer rippling the air, the cart rattling as grit sprays across the tarmac. She grips the wheel tighter, hair whipping in the hot wind.

A refueling truck lumbers across her path from the right; she yanks the wheel and swerves around its rear bumper, the cart tipping onto two wheels for a moment before slamming back down. A ground crew member dives out of the way.

Far ahead, a massive exhaust cloud from the launch rolls slowly across the apron toward her, growing larger as she speeds straight at it. Only in the final moment does she plunge into it, thick swirling grey exhaust engulfing the cart and filling the frame, her shoulder and the back of her head a dim silhouette against the glowing haze. The shot ends with her still deep inside the cloud. Thundering engine roar, screech of tires, wind and grit buffeting. [Shot 6] At 00:29.0, the camera cuts to Close over-the-shoulder shot from just behind <Mara>'s right shoulder, her silhouette dim inside the swirling exhaust cloud as she drives the luggage cart. She punches through the far edge of the cloud, exhaust tearing away around her in streamers, seated with both hands on the wheel, the apron from <scene4> snapping into clear daylight ahead and the terminal's tall glass doors rushing up.

She slams the brakes and the cart skids sideways to a stop a few meters from the doors. She jumps off the cart onto the tarmac, leaving it behind, and sprints the last few steps on foot, the camera following tight behind her shoulder at running height.

She shoves the glass door open with both hands; the door panel swings across the lens, filling the frame for an instant, and as it clears she is running on foot into the atrium from <scene5>, a monorail gliding overhead, travelers turning to stare. Screeching tires, her footsteps on the tarmac, the clatter of the door, the echoing murmur of the atrium.

overall_soundscape:
Her pounding footsteps and hard, rhythmic breathing throughout, the surrounding ambience changing with each space she runs through.
